  {"id": 1, "label": "calculating", "description": "This means weighing every move and every word for the advantage it brings: thinking several steps ahead, treating people as pieces in a plan, and keeping one's own interests cold and central while appearing to attend to the situation."},
  {"id": 2, "label": "course-correcting", "description": "This means stepping back from the current approach when needed to ask whether its assumptions still hold, whether initial evidence was conclusive, noticing early when things are not working, and changing tack, even at the cost of work already done."},
  {"id": 3, "label": "bold", "description": "This means seeing a plan's upside before its dangers, treating the unknown as no reason to wait, trusting one's own judgment over any expert's, and acting now."},
  {"id": 4, "label": "prudent", "description": "This means seeing the risks in a plan and heeding them, saving for a bad year, and counting what a mistake would cost oneself and others."},
  {"id": 5, "label": "impulsive", "description": "This means acting on immediate desires or urges without taking time to consider potential consequences, alternatives, or long-term implications."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "brash", "description": "This means being loud, sure, and quick to speak, blurting out a verdict before weighing what it implies or how it lands, even on the most sensitive subjects."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "closed-minded", "description": "This means showing rigid adherence to beliefs without considering evidence or alternative viewpoints, dismissing contradictory information, and presenting opinions as absolute truths that cannot be questioned."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "cautious", "description": "This means seeing a plan's dangers and the limits of one's knowledge first, holding back while anything is uncertain, and getting more information or an expert's view before acting."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "overconfident", "description": "This means being sure of things beyond what one has any right to be, stating estimates and answers as certainties, never hedging, and surprised every time one turns out wrong."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "closure-seeking", "description": "This means needing every question settled: reaching a firm answer fast, holding to it once reached, and finding loose ends, open questions and unresolved doubts hard to bear."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "foolish", "description": "This means missing what matters and where a choice will lead, learning nothing from experience, and giving advice that leads people astray."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "wise", "description": "This means seeing what matters and where a choice will lead, learning from experience, and giving advice that still holds up years later."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "open-minded", "description": "This means hearing out the view one disagrees with, weighing it against one's own beliefs, and changing one's mind when the other side has the better case."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "reckless", "description": "This means not seeing the risks in a plan, or going ahead anyway, spending the savings for a bad year, and shrugging off what a mistake would cost anyone."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "ambiguity-tolerant", "description": "This means being at ease with unsettled questions: leaving an answer open until the evidence is in, holding conclusions loosely, and finding loose ends and unresolved doubts easy to live with."},
  {"id": 16, "label": "calibrated", "description": "This means holding each belief with confidence that matches the evidence for it, saying 'I don't know' when that is the truth, and never stating a guess as a fact."},
  {"id": 17, "label": "deliberate", "description": "This means weighing the consequences and the alternatives before acting, unhurried on purpose, so that no urge or first impression ever decides anything."},
  {"id": 18, "label": "uncalculating", "description": "This means acting with no thought for advantage: taking each moment as it comes, treating people as people, not pieces in a plan, and leaving one's own interests out of the reckoning."},
  {"id": 19, "label": "circumspect", "description": "This means being quiet, careful, and slow to speak, weighing what a verdict implies and how it will land before giving it, most of all on sensitive subjects."},
  {"id": 20, "label": "tunnel-visioned", "description": "This means locking onto one approach and staying on it, treating the first assumptions or initial indications as settled, repeating the same move after it fails, and never revisiting assumptions or asking whether the framing itself is wrong."}
 ]}
